from math import gcd


def best_average(a: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
    n = len(a)
    pref = [0] * (n + 1)
    s = 0
    for i, x in enumerate(a):
        s += x
        pref[i + 1] = s

    hull: list[int] = []
    lo = 0
    best_p = -1
    best_q = 1

    for r in range(k, n + 1):
        c = r - k
        pc = pref[c]
        while len(hull) - lo >= 2:
            i = hull[-2]
            j = hull[-1]
            if (pref[j] - pref[i]) * (c - j) >= (pc - pref[j]) * (j - i):
                hull.pop()
            else:
                break
        hull.append(c)

        pr = pref[r]
        while len(hull) - lo >= 2:
            i = hull[lo]
            j = hull[lo + 1]
            if (pref[j] - pref[i]) * (r - i) <= (pr - pref[i]) * (j - i):
                lo += 1
            else:
                break

        i = hull[lo]
        p = pr - pref[i]
        q = r - i
        if p * best_q > best_p * q:
            best_p = p
            best_q = q

    g = gcd(best_p, best_q)
    return [best_p // g, best_q // g]
